senses.gloss:
वल् वल् [cf. rts. 1. बल्, वल्ल्, वृ], cl. 1.
A. वलते, ववले, वलितुम्, to cover,
enclose; to be covered or surrounded, to be enclosed;
to move round in a circle; to go, approach, hasten;
to be attached to, be drawn towards; to move to
and fro; to increase: Caus. वलयति or वालयति,
to cause to move, move; to cherish, &c. (see बाल-
यति under rt. 2. बल्); [cf. Hib. falaim, ‘I hedge,
enclose.’]

वल्ल् वल्ल् [cf. rt. वल्], cl. 1. A. वल्लते,
ववल्ले, वल्लितुम्, to be covered; to go,
move.

वल, अस्, m., Ved. a cloud (according to Naigh. I.
10); N. of an Asura (fabled to have stolen the cows
of the gods and to have concealed them in a cave;
Indra surrounded the cave with his army and recovered
the cattle; in Ṛg-veda X. 68, 9, he is said to have
assumed the form of a bull and to have been destroyed
by Bṛhas-pati; elsewhere he is identified with a
cloud); (अम्), n. strength, force; an army, &c. (see
बल).
—वलं-रुज, अस्, m., Ved. one who breaks
the clouds.

वल; to अस्, m., Ved. add — (according to B. R.)
a cave, hollow; a covering.

वल्ल, अस्, m. covering; winnowing corn; a
Māṣa of silver; a weight of three Raktikās or
Ratīs; prohibiting, prohibition.

वाल वाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वल्?), hair; (अस्,
आ), m. f. a tail; [cf. बाल.]
—वाल-धि, वाल-हस्त,
&c., see बाल-धि, &c.

वाल; add — (probably only a later form of
2. वार).
वलग (?) , a kind of magical Mantra.

वलन, अम्, n. turning, moving round in a circle;
agitation; deflection (in astronomy).
—वलनांश
(˚न-अं˚), अस्, m. a degree of deflection.

वलभि, इस्, m. or वलभी, f. (also written व-
डभि), the wooden frame of a thatch, a roof; a
turret or temporary building on the roof of a house;
= वल्लभी.
—वलभि-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.

वलय, अस्, अम्, m. n. (sometimes written ब-
लय), a bracelet, armlet, ring; a zone, girdle of a
married woman; a circle, boundary, circumference,
(दिग्-वलय, the circumference of the sky, the
universe); (अस्), m. a boundary, enclosure, fence;
a branch; sore throat, inflammation of the larynx,
&c.
—वलय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of or en-
dowed with bracelets, &c.
—वलयी-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, made into a bracelet or girdle, girdled.
—वलयी-
कृत-वासुकि, इस्, m. ‘who has made the serpent Vā-
suki his bracelet, ‘epithet of Śiva.
—वलयी-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, become or serving as a girdle, surrounding.

वलयित, अस्, आ, अम्, encircled, surrounded, encom-
passed, enclosed; whirling round.
वलयिन् in ज्योतिर्-लेखा-व्˚, q. v.
वलयिन्; add — (ई, इनी, इ), having a bracelet.

वलाक, अस्, m. (also written बलाक, q. v.), a
crane; (आ), f. a female crane; a crane in general;
a flight of cranes; a mistress or loved woman; (आ,
ई), f. a small kind of crane.

वालक वालक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वल्; cf. व-
लय), a bracelet; a finger-ring, (also आ, f.)

वलक, अस्, m. a covering, cover; (अम्), n. a
procession, B. R.
वलाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having or attended by cranes.

वलि, इस्, m. (usually written बलि, q. v.), tax,
tribute, offering, oblation, &c. (see बलि); (इस्, ई),
f. a line or streak made with fragrant unguents on
the person; a natural line or fold of skin, wrinkle,
fold of skin over the navel (especially of women).
—वलि-क्रिया, f. making offerings to all beings;
making lines on the person, &c.
—वलि-मुख,
&c., see बलि-मुख.
वली, f. See under वलि above.

वल्लि, इस्, or वल्ली, f. a creeper, any climbing or
creeping plant; (इस्), f. the earth; (ई), f. a plant,
Ligusticum Ajwæn; N. of an Upaniṣad.
—वल्लि-
कण्टकारिका, f. the plant Solanum Jacquini.
—वल्लि-
दूर्वा, f. a kind of grass.
—वल्लि-शाकट-पोतिका, f.
= मूल-पोती.
—वल्लि-सूरण, अस्, m. a kind of
plant (= अत्यम्ल-पर्णी).
—वल्ली-गड, अस्, m. a
kind of fish (commonly called भोला or बालिकडा).
—वल्ली-ज, अम्, n. ‘creeper-grown,’ pepper.
—वल्ली-
मुद्ग, अस्, m. a kind of kidney-bean.
—वल्ली-
वदरी, f. a kind of plant (= भू-वदरी).
—वल्ली-
वृक्ष, अस्, m. the Śāl tree, Shorea Robusta; [cf.
शाल, साल.]
वालि वालि. See बालि.

वलिक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the edge of a thatched
roof.
वलीक, अम्, n. the edge of a thatched roof.

वलिभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the fold of skin called
वलि; having wrinkles, wrinkled, (see बलिभ.)

वलूक, अम्, n. the root of a lotus; (अस्), m. a
bird.

वालुका वालुका, f. (more commonly written
बालुका, q. v.), sand, gravel; (ई), f. a species of
cucumber.
—वालुकेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚का-ईश्˚), अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha.
वलूल, अस्, आ, अम्, = बलूल, strong, powerful.

वल्क, अम्, n. the bark of a tree; the scales of a
fish.
—वल्क-तरु, उस्, m. a species of tree (=
पूग).
—वल्क-द्रुम, अस्, m. a kind of birch
tree.
—वल्क-लोध्र, अस्, m. a kind of Lodhra
tree; = पट्टिका-लोध्र.
—वल्क-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having bark, having scales; wearing a bark dress;
(आन्), m. a fish.
—वल्क-वासस्, अस्, n. clothing
made of bark.
वल्क वल्क, वल्कल. See col. 2.

वाल्क वाल्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वल्क), made of
the bark of trees.

वल्कल, अस्, अम्, m. n. the bark of a tree; a
garment made of bark (worn by ascetics, &c.); (आ),
f. = शिला-वल्का, a medicinal substance said to be of
cooling and lithonthryptic properties, (commonly
called सिलाबाक्.)
—वल्कल-क्षेत्र-माहात्म्य,
अम्, n. ‘the praise of Valkala-kṣetra,’ part of the
Adhyātma-rāmāyaṇa.
—वल्कल-संवीत, अस्, आ,
अम्, clad in bark, clothed in a bark dress.
—वल्क-
लाजिन-संवृत (˚ल-अज्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, clad in bark
and deer-skin.

वल्कलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dressed in bark, clothed in a
bark dress.
वल्किल, अस्, m. a thorn.
वल्कुत, अम्, n. bark, rind.

वलकेश्वरतीर्थ वलकेश्वर-तीर्थ (˚क-ईश्˚),
अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

वलक्ष वलक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, white; (अस्), m.
white, the colour; [cf. पलक्ष, बलक्ष, अव-
लक्ष.]
—वलक्ष-गु, उस्, m. ‘having white
rays of light, ‘the moon.

वलग्न व-लग्न, अस्, अम्, m. n. = अव-
लग्न, the waist, middle.

वलन्तिका वलन्तिका, f. a particular air or
mode in music.

वलम्ब व-लम्ब, अस्, m. = अव-लम्ब, a
perpendicular.
वलम्भ वलम्भ, N. of a country.

वलासक वलासक, अस्, m. (perhaps for अव-
लासक), the Koïl or Indian cuckoo; a frog.

वलाहक वलाहक, अस्, m. a cloud, thunder-
cloud; N. of one of the seven clouds at the destruc-
tion of the world; a mountain; a kind of crane
(= वलाक); N. of a Daitya; of a brother of Jayad-
ratha; one of the Nāgas; one of the four horses of
Viṣṇu.

वलिर वलिर, अस्, आ, अम्, squint-eyed,
squinting.

वलिश वलिश, अम्, ई, n. f. or वलिशि, इस्, f. a
fish-hook; [cf. वडिश.]

वलिशान वलिशान, अस्, m., Ved. a cloud
(Naigh. I. 10).

वल्क् वल्क्, cl. 10. P. वल्कयति, -यितुम्,
to speak.

वल्ग् वल्ग्, cl. 1. P. वल्गति, ववल्ग,
वल्गितुम्, to go, move; to go by leaps,
jump, bounce; to gallop; to move in different ways;
to fluctuate; [cf. perhaps Angl. Sax. wlœnce; Engl.
walk.]
वल्गत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, jumping.

वल्गन, अम्, n. the act of going by leaps, bound-
ing, jumping.

वल्गा, f. a bridle, rein.
—वल्गाङ्क (˚गा-अङ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, holding a bridle.

वल्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, leaped, jumped, gone by
bounds or leaps; (अम्), n. a bound, gallop, one of
the paces of a horse.

वल्गु वल्गु, उस्, उस्, उ (according to Uṇādi-s.
I. 20. fr. rt. वल्; according to others fr. rt. वल्ग्),
handsome, beautiful, lovely, sweet, precious; (उ),
ind. beautifully; (उस्), m. a goat.
—वल्गु-पत्त्र,
अस्, m. a sort of wild pulse (= वन-मुद्ग).

वल्गुक, अस्, आ, अम्, handsome, beautiful; (अम्),
n. sandal; a wood; price.

वल्गुल, अस्, m. the flying fox; (आ), f. a species
of bird.
वल्गुलिका, f. a cockroach.
वल्गुलिका; add — a box, chest; a kind of bat.

वल्गूय, Nom. P. वल्गूयति, -यितुम्, to be
beautiful or handsome; to be mild or gentle; to
honour, praise, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 50, 70 =
स्तौति).

वल्गूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming handsome or
beautiful; honouring.

वल्भ् वल्भ्, cl. 1. A. वल्भते, ववल्भे,
वल्भितुम्, to eat, devour.
वल्भन, अम्, n. the act of eating; food.
वल्भित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten, devoured.

वल्मी वल्मी, f. an ant; [cf. वम्री; per-
haps for वर्मी.]
—वल्मी-कूट, अम्, n. an ant-hill,
hillock.

वल्मिक, अस्, m. for वल्मीक, an ant-hill, &c.;
see below.

वल्मीक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (in Uṇādi-s. IV. 25.
derived fr. rt. वल्), an ant-hill, mole-hill, a hillock
or ground thrown up by white ants, moles, &c.;
(अस्), m. swelling of the neck or of the chest and
other parts of the body, elephantiasis; the poet
Vālmīki.
—वल्मीक-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, being of
the size of an ant-hill.
—वल्मीक-शीर्ष, अम्, n. a
kind of antimony (used as a collyrium).

वाल्मीक वाल्मीक, अस्, m. (fr. वल्मीक, q. v.)
= वाल्मीकि below; a proper N.
—वाल्मीकेश्वर-
तीर्थ (˚क-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
वल्मिकि, इस्, इ, m. n. an ant-hill, &c.; see below.

वाल्मीकि, इस्, m. (also spelt वाल्मिकि), N. of the
celebrated author of the Rāmāyaṇa, (so called, ac-
cording to some, because when immersed in thought
he allowed himself to be overrun with ants like an
ant-hill; according to one tradition he began life as
a robber, but repenting of his misdeeds betook him-
self to a hermitage on a hill in the district of Banda
in Bundelkund, where he eventually received Sītā,
the wife of Rāma, when banished by her husband.)

वल्युल् वल्युल् or वल्यूल् [cf. पल्युल्],
cl. 10. P. वल्यूलयति, -यितुम्, to
cut, cut off; to purify.
वल्लकी, f. the Vīṇā or Indian lute.

वल्लभ, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. III. 125. said
to be fr. rt. वल्ल्), beloved, desired, dear; supreme,
superintending, superintendent; (अस्), m. a lover,
husband, friend, favourite, (काम-वल्लभ, the
cinnamon tree); a superintendent, overseer; a chief
herdsman; a horse (especially one with good marks);
N. of a grammarian; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people;
(आ), f. a beloved female, wife, mistress; (ई), f., N. of
a city in Gujarāt, the capital of a line of kings.
—वल्लभ-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most beloved, dear-
est.
—वल्लभ-ता, f. or वल्लभ-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of being loved or a favourite, love.
—वल्लभ-
देव, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
—वल्लभ-पालक, अस्,
m. a horse-keeper, groom.
—वल्लभाचार्य (˚भ-
आच्˚), अस्, m., N. of a great teacher of the Vaiṣṇava
sect, (he was a successor of a less celebrated teacher
named Viṣṇu-svāmin, and his followers are some-
times called Vallabhācāryas, sometimes Rudra-sam-
pradāyins; he was born, it is said, in the forest of
Campāraṇya in 1479; at an early age he commenced
travelling to propagate his doctrines, and at the court
of Kṛṣṇa-deva, king of Vijaya-nagara, succeeded
so well in his controversies with the Śaivas that the
Vaiṣṇavas chose him as their chief; he then went
to other parts of India, and finally settled down at
Benares, where he composed seventeen works, the
most important of which were a commentary on the
Vedānta and Mīmāṃsā Sūtras and another on the Bhā-
gavata-Purāṇa, which last, as inculcating the worship
of Kṛṣṇa, is the chief religious work on which this
sect rest their doctrines; he left behind eighty-four
disciples, of each of whom some history or story is
told, which stories are often repeated to large audiences
on festive or solemn occasions; the Tilaka mark on
the forehead of the Vallabhācāryas is described as
consisting of two perpendicular lines meeting in a
semicircle at the root of the nose and having a round
spot of red between them.)
—वल्लभाष्टक-वि-
वृति (˚भ-अष्˚), इस्, f., N. of a work.

वल्लभायित, अम्, n. a kind of coitus; [cf. पु-
रुषायित.]

वल्लर, अम्, n. Agallochum or aloe wood (the
black variety).

वल्लरि, इस्, or वल्लरी, f. a branching foot-stalk,
compound pedicle; a creeping or twining plant.

वल्लव, अस्, m. a herdsman [cf. गो-व्˚]; a name
of Bhīma-sena; a cook; (ई), f. a cowherdess.

वालव वालव, अस्, m. the second of the
eleven Karaṇas or astrological divisions of time, (see
करण.)

वल्लुर, अम्, n. an arbour, bower; any place
overgrown with creeping plants; a thicket, wood; an
uncultivated field or place overrun with wild grass;
a desert, place destitute of water, wilderness, wild,
solitude; a field; a branching foot-stalk, compound
pedicle.

वल्लूर, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. dried flesh; hog's
flesh, the flesh of the wild hog; (अम्), n. an uncul-
tivated field or one overrun with grass; a thicket;
a desert (= वन-क्षेत्र; = वाहन; = ऊषर-
भूमि).
वल्ल्या, f. Emblic Myrobalan (= धात्री).
वल्व वल्व. See बल्व, p. 677, col. 1.

वल्वज वल्वज, अस्, m. (also written बल्-
बज, q. v.), a sort of coarse grass, Eleusine Indica;
(आ), f. a kind of grass (called in Hindī सावे वागे
and, according to some, a different species from
वल्वज, its synonyms are तृण-वल्वजा, तृणेक्षु
[]
दृढ-क्षुरा, दृढ-तृणा, दृढ-पत्त्री, पा-
नीयाश्रा, मौञ्जी-पत्त्रा).

वल्श वल्श, अस्, m. (or अम्, n.?), Ved. a
branch; [cf. सहस्र-व्˚.]

वल्ह् वल्ह् (also written बल्ह्; cf. rt.
वर्ह्), cl. 1. A. वल्हते, &c., to be
good or excellent, be pre-eminent; to speak; to kill,
hurt; to give or to cover; cl. 10. P. वल्हयति,
&c., to speak, tell; to shine.

वल्हिक वल्हिक, वल्हीक, = बल्हिक, बल्-
हीक, q. q. v. v.

वालखिल्य वालखिल्य, अम्, n. a collection
of eleven additional or apocryphal hymns inserted
between the forty-eighth and forty-ninth hymns of
the eighth Maṇḍala of the Ṛg-veda; [cf. बाल-
खिल्य.]

वालम्मदेश वालम्म-देश, अस्, m., N. of a
country.
वालवितु वालवितु, उस्, m. a proper N.

वालिखिल्येश्वरतीर्थ वालिखिल्येश्वर-तीर्थ
(˚य-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
वालुकिन्, ई, m. = भालुकिन्.
वाल्मीकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, composed by Vālmīki.

वाल्लभ्य वाल्लभ्य, अम्, n. (fr. वल्लभ), the
state of being a favourite or of being beloved.
वलभिका, f. a particular poisonous insect.
वल्गुली, f. a kind of bat.
